response: {"__model_dump_json__": "{\"statements\":[\"The answer to the question is no.\",\"According to Meridian\u2019s Business Travel Policy (travel.md), any international trip or any trip with a total cost exceeding $2,000 must be approved by a manager at Director level or above.\",\"The requirement applies regardless of the traveler\u2019s own seniority.\",\"Even a Director would need a second Director\u2011or\u2011above approver for the Director\u2019s own qualifying trip.\",\"A Senior Manager is tier 3 in the seniority hierarchy (below Director), so a Senior Manager does not meet the Director level or above threshold.\",\"Therefore a Senior Manager cannot approve the Senior Manager's own $2,500 international trip; the trip would need sign\u2011off from an individual holding a Director, Vice President, or higher title.\"]}"}
